The fine-tuned Transformer LM scores **57.4% on RACE-h**. The previous best was **50.3%**, from BiAttention MRU [59], an ensemble of 9 models (Table 3, page 6).

That is a gain of about 7.1 points. My subtraction isn't stated in the paper, which only gives the overall RACE gain of 5.7% (59.0 vs. 53.3) (page 6). The paper notes that RACE comes from middle and high school English exams, and RACE-h is the high-school portion (page 6).
